# FUSE and the order of the rater columns (generated by scripts/run_fuse_order.py)

FUSE logistic with paper defaults. 'Spread' = max - min AUC over 8 random column orders of the same panel. 'Averaged' = FUSE scores averaged over the same orders (no labels used). The last column compares averaged FUSE with the best of the four baselines (± 95% over draws).

## 1. Simulation (10 seeds, 1000 items, 30% positive)

| Panel | FUSE, original order | FUSE, one random order (mean) | Spread over orders (median) | FUSE, averaged over 8 orders | D&S 5 bins | Mean z | D&S -> logistic | Detector + D&S | Averaged FUSE minus best baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5 humans + 6 LLMs (d=0.3), shared noise 0.0 | 94.2 | 91.0 | 5.1 | **93.0** | 93.9 | 91.5 | 95.2 | 93.9 | -2.2 ± 2.4 (D&S -> logistic) |
| 5 humans + 6 LLMs (d=0.3), shared noise 0.15 | 92.0 | 87.9 | 12.1 | **88.4** | 87.9 | 88.1 | 89.0 | 87.9 | -0.6 ± 3.0 (D&S -> logistic) |
| 5 humans + 6 LLMs (d=0.5), shared noise 0.15 | 94.2 | 91.3 | 6.8 | **91.7** | 90.8 | 91.9 | 91.7 | 90.8 | -0.2 ± 0.6 (Mean z) |
| 5 humans + 6 LLMs (d=0.5), shared noise 0.2 | 92.8 | 88.7 | 9.8 | **89.3** | 86.4 | 90.9 | 87.2 | 86.4 | -1.5 ± 0.6 (Mean z) |
| 10 humans + 6 LLMs (d=0.3), shared noise 0.3 | 96.9 | 91.6 | 11.8 | **91.5** | 91.3 | 94.1 | 91.6 | 91.3 | -2.6 ± 2.4 (Mean z) |
| 10 humans + 6 LLMs (d=0.3), shared noise 0.6 | 81.6 | 72.3 | 14.0 | **72.7** | 63.5 | 90.8 | 63.5 | 98.2 | -25.4 ± 2.7 (Detector + D&S) |
